1. Present suit is for cancellation / declaration and permanent injunction.
BRIEF FACTS 2.

The case of the plaintiff is that in the year 2010, he had purchased a leasehold property, area measuring 60 sq. mtr. situated at DDA Plot No. 25, Pocket-03, Sector-24, Rohini Residential Scheme, Delhi (hereinafter referred to as Suit Property).
He had purchased the suit property from Mrs. Sangeeta Gupta W/o. Sh. Rajesh Gupta, R/o 21/35, Shakti Nagar, Delhi vide registered GPA and agreement to sell.

Thereafter, in the year 2012, on the basis of the above said registered documents, the suit property was transferred in his name by the DDA through Conveyance Deed dated 22.02.2012 registered in the office of Sub Registrar-VII, Delhi with Reg. No. 3180 in Book No.
1, Vol. No. 4302, Pg. 188 to 190 on 22.02.2012.
He got converted the suit property from leasehold to freehold after paying necessary charges to DDA.
He is the legal and absolute owner of the suit property .
Rajinder Kumar vs. Ishwar Singh & ors.

It is stated that he is a permanent resident of Dehradun where he is living since his retirement.
In the month of October 2021, it had come to his knowledge through e-portal online record of Registrar that a sale deed has been executed in the name of defendant no.1.

Upon further inquiry, it came to his knowledge that all the defendants on the basis of forged and fabricated documents have got executed the forged sale deed dated 20.09.2021 through impersonation in order to grab the suit property.
It is stated that on 20.09.2021 i.e. the date of registration of the forged sale deed, he was present in Dehradun.
The defendants being impersonators and fraudsters have prepared fabricated documents and managed to get a registered sale deed through impersonation with the intent to cheat and defraud him.
2.2. It is stated that the photograph of the seller in the sale deed dated 20.09.2021 is not his photograph.
The PAN Card and Aadhar Card details mentioned in the sale deed do not belong to him.
Even the date of birth is wrongly mentioned in the said sale deed.
His signatures on the sale deed have been forged.
He had never received any sale consideration as mentioned in the sale deed.
He had filed a complaint before defendant no. 4 i.e. Sub Registrar VI D, Rohini, Delhi on 26.10.2021 against defendant no. 1 to 3.

hence, the present suit.
It is prayed that decree of cancellation / declaration be passed in his favor and against defendants thereby canceling the sale deed dated 20.09.2021 as the same is illegal and void ab-initio.

It is further prayed that decree of permanent injunction be passed in his favor and against the defendants, thereby restraining the defendants, their agents, attorneys, assignees and representatives to not to create any third party interest or part with possession of the suit property.
3. In the written statement filed on behalf of defendant no. 1, it is stated that plaintiff has no locus standi to file the present suit.

The suit is without any cause of action.
It is stated that in fact, he himself is a victim of the circumstances as he has been cheated by the imposter/seller Rajinder Kumar, Jai Bhagwan, Krishan Kumar Rajinder Kumar vs. Ishwar Singh & ors.

GUPTA GUPTA 2026.01.03 15:10:43 +0530 ANALYSIS AND FINDINGS 7.
Heard counsel for the plaintiff and perused the complete record file.
The case of the plaintiff is that he is the owner of the suit property by virtue of the Conveyance Deed Ex.PW1/4.
It is alleged that he came to know that defendant no. 1 and 2 in collusion and by impersonation have got the sale deed of the suit property dated 20.09.2021 registered in the name of defendant no. 1.

The plaintiff has categorically stated that the registered sale deed dated 20.09.2021 in favor of defendant no. 1 is a forged and fabricated sale deed obtained by impersonation and the same was never executed by him.
The defendant no. 1 in his written statement has admitted that the sale deed dated 20.09.2021 was not executed by the plaintiff.

Infact, he has pleaded that he is the victim and has been cheated by imposter Rajinder Kumar (Adhar card no. 302739967134), Jai Bhagwan, Krishan Kumar and various other persons and they have executed the sale deed of the suit property in his name.

Thus,
he has not denied the ownership of the plaintiff qua the suit property and has admitted that some imposter Rajinder Kumar had executed the sale deed in his favor.

The plaintiff has examined PW6,
the concerned official from UIDAI Office that the Aadhar bearing no. 302739967134 is presently de-activated.
The plaintiff has placed on record various documents to show that the Aadhar card number & PAN Card Number as stated in the sale deed dated 20.09.2021 does not Rajinder Kumar vs. Ishwar Singh & ors.

8. In view of the above discussion, the plaintiff has successfully proved that he has not executed the sale deed dated 20.09.2021 in favor of defendant no. 1 and that the said sale deed is a forged and fabricated document.

Accordingly, the registered sale deed dated 20.09.2021 registered in the office of Sub Registrar, VI D, with registration no. 4723 in Book No. 1, Vol. No. 1871, Page 63 to 72 in favor of defendant no. 1 is hereby canceled and declared as illegal.

The defendant no. 1 and 2 are permanently restrained not to create any third party interest in the suit property i.e. area measuring 60 sq. mts., Plot no. 25, Pocket - 3, Sector 24, Rohini Residential Scheme, Delhi on the basis of the sale deed dated 20.09.2021.
The suit of the plaintiff is decreed.
No order as to costs.
Decree sheet be prepared accordingly.
File be consigned to record room.
